about: Starter source packs. Each pack adds one topic and the trusted websites mapped to it. Sites you already have are mapped to the topic, not added twice.

packs.name: South Asian history
packs.description: National archives, digital libraries and reference works on India, Bangladesh and the wider region.

topic.name: South Asian history
topic.description: Archives, digital libraries and reference works on the history of South Asia.

packs.exampleClaim: The Permanent Settlement of 1793 impoverished the peasantry of Bengal.

sources.label: Banglapedia
sources.notes: National Encyclopedia of Bangladesh, published by the Asiatic Society of Bangladesh. Strong on Bengal.

sources.label: Digital South Asia Library
sources.notes: University of Chicago: gazetteers, maps, dictionaries and statistical records.

sources.label: Indian Culture portal
sources.notes: Government of India portal: rare books, manuscripts, archival records.

sources.label: Abhilekh Patal (National Archives of India)
sources.notes: Digitised records from the National Archives of India.

sources.label: Internet Archive
sources.notes: Digitised books, gazetteers and periodicals. Check the uploader and edition.

sources.label: JSTOR
sources.notes: Peer-reviewed journals. Often only abstracts are searchable.

sources.label: Encyclopaedia Britannica
sources.notes: Edited reference work; good for dates, names and established narratives.

packs.name: World history
packs.audience: History students, Model UN, quiz teams
packs.description: Primary-source collections, national archives and edited reference works.

topic.name: World history
topic.description: Primary-source collections, national archives and reference works on world history.

packs.exampleClaim: The Treaty of Versailles required Germany to accept sole responsibility for the First World War.

sources.label: Avalon Project (Yale Law School)
sources.notes: Full texts of treaties, charters and other documents in law, history and diplomacy.

sources.label: Internet History Sourcebooks (Fordham)
sources.notes: Translated primary texts for ancient, medieval and modern history.

sources.label: US National Archives
sources.notes: Founding documents and US government records.

sources.label: The National Archives (UK)
sources.notes: UK government records, including colonial administration.

sources.label: Library of Congress
sources.notes: Digitised collections, maps and newspapers.

sources.label: Heilbrunn Timeline of Art History (The Met)
sources.notes: Curator-written essays on cultures and periods worldwide.

sources.label: Encyclopaedia Britannica
sources.notes: Edited reference work; good for dates, names and established narratives.

sources.label: World History Encyclopedia
sources.notes: Edited, non-profit encyclopedia. Quality varies by author: follow its own citations.

packs.name: Indian law and policy
packs.description: Statutes, gazettes, court judgments and independent legislative research for India.

topic.name: Indian law and policy
topic.description: Statutes, gazettes, judgments and legislative research for India.

packs.exampleClaim: The Right to Information Act, 2005 requires public authorities to answer requests within 30 days.

sources.label: India Code
sources.notes: Official repository of central and state Acts, with amendments.

sources.label: e-Gazette of India
sources.notes: Official notifications, rules and orders as published.

sources.label: Legislative Department
sources.notes: The Constitution of India and central legislation.

sources.label: Supreme Court of India
sources.notes: Judgments and orders of the Supreme Court.

sources.label: Indian Kanoon
sources.notes: Searchable judgments and statutes. Unofficial: check important text against the court's own copy.

sources.label: PRS Legislative Research
sources.notes: Independent, non-partisan summaries of bills, budgets and policy.

sources.label: Law Commission of India
sources.notes: Reports recommending legal reform.

sources.label: Press Information Bureau
sources.notes: Official government statements. Shows what the government says, not independent confirmation.

packs.name: Health and medicine
packs.audience: Students, health workers, anyone checking a health claim
packs.description: Systematic reviews, research databases and public-health bodies.

topic.name: Health and medicine
topic.description: Systematic reviews, research databases and public-health bodies.

packs.exampleClaim: Antibiotics are effective against the common cold.

sources.label: Cochrane Library
sources.notes: Systematic reviews: the strongest level of evidence for treatments.

sources.label: PubMed
sources.notes: Abstracts of biomedical research. Check study type and size.

sources.label: World Health Organization
sources.notes: International guidance and fact sheets.

sources.label: US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
sources.notes: Public-health guidance and data.

sources.label: NHS (UK)
sources.notes: Plain-language condition and treatment pages, clinically reviewed.

sources.label: MedlinePlus
sources.notes: US National Library of Medicine's plain-language health information.

sources.label: Indian Council of Medical Research
sources.notes: Indian research body: guidelines and studies.

sources.label: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
sources.notes: Official Indian health policy and advisories.

packs.name: Economics and development
packs.description: Central banks, official statistics and international institutions.

topic.name: Economics and development
topic.description: Central banks, official statistics and international institutions.

packs.exampleClaim: India's economy grew faster than China's in 2023.

sources.label: Reserve Bank of India
sources.notes: Monetary policy, bulletins and the Handbook of Statistics on the Indian Economy.

sources.label: Ministry of Statistics (MoSPI)
sources.notes: Official GDP, price and survey data for India.

sources.label: Union Budget and Economic Survey
sources.notes: Budget documents and the annual Economic Survey.

sources.label: World Bank
sources.notes: Development data and reports (includes data.worldbank.org).

sources.label: International Monetary Fund
sources.notes: World Economic Outlook and country reports. Forecasts are revised often: check the date.

sources.label: OECD
sources.notes: Comparative economic and social statistics.

sources.label: National Bureau of Economic Research
sources.notes: Working papers: research quality, but not yet peer reviewed.

packs.name: Climate and environment
packs.description: Scientific assessments, weather and climate agencies, and environmental regulators.

topic.name: Climate and environment
topic.description: Climate assessments, weather agencies and environmental bodies.

packs.exampleClaim: The last decade was the warmest on record globally.

sources.label: IPCC
sources.notes: Assessment reports summarising the peer-reviewed climate science.

sources.label: World Meteorological Organization
sources.notes: State of the Global Climate reports and records.

sources.label: NOAA
sources.notes: US climate and ocean data.

sources.label: NASA
sources.notes: Climate and Earth-observation data and explainers.

sources.label: UN Environment Programme
sources.notes: Emissions Gap reports and environmental assessments.

sources.label: India Meteorological Department
sources.notes: Official weather and climate records for India.

sources.label: Central Pollution Control Board
sources.notes: Air and water quality data for India.

packs.name: News fact-checks
packs.audience: Anyone checking a viral post or forward
packs.description: Independent fact-checkers in India and abroad. Useful for viral claims, forwards and quotes.
packs.exampleClaim: The new ₹2000 note has a GPS nano-chip that tracks where it is.

sources.label: Alt News
sources.notes: Indian fact-checker, signatory of the IFCN code of principles.

sources.label: BOOM
sources.notes: Indian fact-checker, signatory of the IFCN code of principles.

sources.label: Factly
sources.notes: Indian fact-checker focused on public data and government claims.

sources.label: AFP Fact Check
sources.notes: Global news agency's fact-checking service, with Indian coverage.

sources.label: Reuters Fact Check
sources.notes: News agency fact-checks.

sources.label: Full Fact
sources.notes: UK independent fact-checker.

sources.label: FactCheck.org
sources.notes: US non-partisan fact-checker (Annenberg Public Policy Center).

packs.name: Mathematics and logic
packs.description: Reference works on mathematics, logic and the philosophy of reasoning.

topic.name: Mathematics and logic
topic.description: Reference works on mathematics and logic.

packs.exampleClaim: If all squares are rectangles and this shape is a rectangle, then it is a square.

sources.label: Wolfram MathWorld
sources.notes: Edited mathematics encyclopedia.

sources.label: Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy
sources.notes: Peer-reviewed entries, including logic and reasoning.

sources.label: Internet Encyclopedia of Philosophy
sources.notes: Peer-reviewed philosophy encyclopedia, including fallacies.

sources.label: NIST Digital Library of Mathematical Functions
sources.notes: Authoritative reference for special functions and formulas.

sources.label: OEIS
sources.notes: The On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences.

sources.label: arXiv
sources.notes: Preprints: often important, but not peer reviewed.
